mapper.sql: tenant_id,source_event_id,memory_type,canonical_fact_key as canonical_key, agent_id,source_target_kind,source_target_id,end_user_id,source_session_id as session_id, source_execution_id,source_event_type,policy_version, source_time_epoch_second,source_time_nano,model_status,system_run_id,configuration_ref,invocation_ref,claim_token, integration_id,group_binding_id::text as group_binding_id
and status='PROCESSING' and claim_token=#{job.claimToken} and lease_until>clock_timestamp()
mapper.select: select from agent_runtime_memory_extraction_jobs where tenant_id=#{tenant} and extractor_version=#{extractor} and policy_version=#{policy} and (status in ('READY','WAITING','ACK_PENDING') or status='PROCESSING' and lease_until<clock_timestamp()) and available_at<=clock_timestamp() order by created_at,source_event_id for update skip locked limit 1
mapper.update: update agent_runtime_memory_extraction_jobs set status='PROCESSING',attempts=attempts+1, claimed_at=clock_timestamp(),lease_until=clock_timestamp()+interval '5 minutes',claim_token=#{job.claimToken},updated_at=clock_timestamp() where and (status in ('READY','WAITING','ACK_PENDING') or status='PROCESSING' and lease_until<clock_timestamp())

update agent_runtime_memory_extraction_jobs set source_time_epoch_second=#{input.sourceTimeEpochSecond},source_time_nano=#{input.sourceTimeNano}, frozen_fact_count=#{input.factCount},frozen_subject_count=#{input.subjectCount},updated_at=clock_timestamp() where and source_time_epoch_second IS NULL
mapper.select: select source_time_epoch_second as epoch_second,source_time_nano as nano from agent_runtime_memory_extraction_jobs where and source_time_epoch_second is not null
select alias,fact_id,fact_revision as revision from agent_runtime_memory_extraction_fact_aliases where order by alias_ordinal
mapper.insert: insert into agent_runtime_memory_extraction_sources(tenant_id,source_event_id,extractor_version,policy_version,memory_type,canonical_fact_key,source_alias,source_ordinal) select tenant_id,source_event_id,extractor_version,policy_version,memory_type,canonical_fact_key,'s0',0 from agent_runtime_memory_extraction_jobs where
mapper.select: select subject_end_user_id from agent_runtime_memory_extraction_subjects where order by subject_ordinal
mapper.insert: insert into agent_runtime_memory_extraction_subjects(tenant_id,source_event_id,extractor_version,policy_version, memory_type,canonical_fact_key,subject_ordinal,subject_end_user_id) select tenant_id,source_event_id,extractor_version,policy_version,memory_type,canonical_fact_key,#{ordinal},#{subject} from agent_runtime_memory_extraction_jobs where
mapper.select: select claim_token from agent_runtime_memory_extraction_jobs where for update
mapper.update: update agent_runtime_memory_extraction_jobs set model_status=#{status},system_run_id=#{run}, configuration_ref=#{configuration},invocation_ref=#{invocation},updated_at=clock_timestamp() where and (model_status is null or model_status='WAITING') and ((system_run_id is null and configuration_ref is null and invocation_ref is null) or (system_run_id is not distinct from #{run} and configuration_ref is not distinct from #{configuration} and invocation_ref is not distinct from #{invocation}))
mapper.sql: exists(select 1 from agent_runtime_memory_extraction_jobs j where j.tenant_id=c.tenant_id and j.source_event_id=c.source_event_id and j.extractor_version=c.extractor_version and j.policy_version=c.policy_version and j.memory_type=c.memory_type and j.canonical_fact_key=c.canonical_fact_key and j.status='PROCESSING' and j.claim_token=#{job.claimToken} and j.lease_until>clock_timestamp())
mapper.select: select candidate_ordinal as ordinal,command_key,state as status,candidate_type as type,subject,predicate,value_json::text as value_json, signal,sensitive,candidate_scope as scope,temporal_kind,temporal_from_epoch_second,temporal_from_nano, temporal_to_epoch_second,temporal_to_nano,relation_kind,relation_target,condition_count,uncertainty_count,evidence_count, target_fact_id,target_revision,fact_id,fact_revision,error_code from agent_runtime_memory_extraction_candidates c where order by candidate_ordinal
mapper.insert: insert into agent_runtime_memory_extraction_candidates(tenant_id,source_event_id,extractor_version,policy_version, memory_type,canonical_fact_key,candidate_ordinal,command_key,candidate_type,subject,predicate,value_json,signal,sensitive,candidate_scope, temporal_kind,temporal_from_epoch_second,temporal_from_nano,temporal_to_epoch_second,temporal_to_nano,relation_kind,relation_target, condition_count,uncertainty_count,evidence_count) select tenant_id,source_event_id,extractor_version,policy_version,memory_type,canonical_fact_key,#{candidate.ordinal},#{candidate.commandKey}, #{candidate.type},#{candidate.subject},#{candidate.predicate},CAST(#{candidate.valueJson} AS jsonb),#{candidate.signal},#{candidate.sensitive},#{candidate.scope}, #{candidate.temporalKind},#{candidate.temporalFromEpochSecond},#{candidate.temporalFromNano},#{candidate.temporalToEpochSecond},#{candidate.temporalToNano}, #{candidate.relationKind},#{candidate.relationTarget},#{candidate.conditionCount},#{candidate.uncertaintyCount},#{candidate.evidenceCount} from agent_runtime_memory_extraction_jobs where
mapper.select: select prepared_type as type,prepared_scope as scope,retention_class,schema_version,payload_schema_id, valid_from_epoch_second,valid_from_nano,valid_to_epoch_second,valid_to_nano,expires_epoch_second,expires_nano, confidence,importance,review_required,initial_status,target_fact_id,target_revision from agent_runtime_memory_extraction_candidates where and candidate_ordinal=#{ordinal} and prepared_scope is not null
mapper.update: update agent_runtime_memory_extraction_candidates c set prepared_type=#{prepared.type},prepared_scope=#{prepared.scope}, retention_class=#{prepared.retentionClass},schema_version=#{prepared.schemaVersion},payload_schema_id=#{prepared.payloadSchemaId}, valid_from_epoch_second=#{prepared.validFromEpochSecond},valid_from_nano=#{prepared.validFromNano}, valid_to_epoch_second=#{prepared.validToEpochSecond},valid_to_nano=#{prepared.validToNano}, expires_epoch_second=#{prepared.expiresEpochSecond},expires_nano=#{prepared.expiresNano},confidence=#{prepared.confidence},importance=#{prepared.importance}, review_required=#{prepared.reviewRequired},initial_status=#{prepared.initialStatus},review_reason_count=#{prepared.reviewReasonCount}, target_fact_id=#{prepared.targetFactId},target_revision=#{prepared.targetRevision},state='PREPARED',updated_at=clock_timestamp() where and candidate_ordinal=#{ordinal} and state='READY' and prepared_scope is null and
mapper.select: select item_text from agent_runtime_memory_extraction_conditions where and candidate_ordinal=#{ordinal} order by item_ordinal
select item_text from agent_runtime_memory_extraction_uncertainties where and candidate_ordinal=#{ordinal} order by item_ordinal
select item_text from agent_runtime_memory_extraction_review_reasons where and candidate_ordinal=#{ordinal} order by item_ordinal
select source_alias as source_id,quote from agent_runtime_memory_extraction_candidate_evidence where and candidate_ordinal=#{ordinal} order by item_ordinal
mapper.sql: from agent_runtime_memory_extraction_candidates c where and candidate_ordinal=#{ordinal} and
mapper.update: update agent_runtime_memory_extraction_candidates c set state=#{status},fact_id=#{fact},fact_revision=#{revision}, error_code=#{error},updated_at=clock_timestamp() where and candidate_ordinal=#{ordinal} and state in ('READY','PREPARED','ACK_PENDING') and

update agent_runtime_memory_extraction_jobs set status=#{status},result_fact_id=#{fact},result_revision=#{revision}, error_code=#{error},updated_at=clock_timestamp(), completed_at=case when #{status} in ('WAITING','ACK_PENDING','UNKNOWN') then null else clock_timestamp() end, available_at=case when #{status} in ('WAITING','ACK_PENDING') then clock_timestamp()+interval '5 seconds' else available_at end, claimed_at=case when #{status} in ('COMPLETED','SKIPPED') then null else claimed_at end, lease_until=null,claim_token=null where

with expired as (select tenant_id,source_event_id,extractor_version,policy_version,memory_type,canonical_fact_key from agent_runtime_memory_extraction_jobs where tenant_id=#{tenant} and status in ('COMPLETED','SKIPPED') and completed_at is not null and claimed_at is not null order by completed_at,source_event_id limit #{limit} for update skip locked) update agent_runtime_memory_extraction_jobs j set claimed_at=null from expired p where (j.tenant_id,j.source_event_id,j.extractor_version,j.policy_version,j.memory_type,j.canonical_fact_key)= (p.tenant_id,p.source_event_id,p.extractor_version,p.policy_version,p.memory_type,p.canonical_fact_key)
